title: FastManly: An EM-Gradient Algorithm for Manly Mixture Models
abstract: arXiv:2410.00848v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: A faster implementation of mixtures of Manly transformations is proposed. This method, called FastManly, uses Newton's method for optimization in an EM gradient algorithm instead of Nelder-Mead in a traditional EM. A gradient and full Hessian are derived. Simulations show improved performance with noticeable speedups.

translated_title: FastManly：用于Manly混合模型的EM梯度算法
translated_abstract: 本文提出了一种更快速的Manly变换混合模型实现方法。该方法称为FastManly，在EM梯度算法中使用牛顿法进行优化，取代了传统EM算法中的Nelder-Mead方法。文中推导出了梯度以及完整的Hessian矩阵。仿真结果表明该方法性能更优，且速度提升显著。
tldr: FastManly方法通过在EM梯度算法中采用牛顿法（并推导出梯度和完整Hessian矩阵）替代传统EM中的Nelder-Mead优化，显著加快了Manly变换混合模型的计算速度。
en_tdlr: FastManly achieves faster computation of Manly mixture models by replacing Nelder-Mead optimization in traditional EM with Newton's method (with derived gradient and full Hessian) within an EM gradient algorithm, yielding noticeable speedups.
